title: galium rubrum subvar. rubriflorum
intro: Galium rubrum subvar. rubriflorum, commonly known as Red Bedstraw, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its therapeutic actions as an anti-inflammatory and antiseptic agent. The bioactive constituents of Red Bedstraw include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties. However, further research is needed to fully understand the plant's therapeutic effects and optimal uses.
